decisions.decision: The Commission agreed to send the basic ideas and areas of concern on the Lancaster Avenue extension policy, in layman language, to legal counsel for review and help in drafting the policy language.
decisions.quote: the commission would like to send them on to legal counsel for review and help in drafting the language to be included in our sewer extension policy.

decisions.decision: The Commission wants counsel to draft a boilerplate covenant after the policy is set.
decisions.quote: they also want counsel to draft a boiler plate covenant after the policy is set.

budget_items.topic: Privilege fee for lots that participated in extension cost
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Draft policy language would charge lots that participated in the extension cost a privilege fee of 50% of the cost of the most recent completed betterment, whether or not they connect.
budget_items.quote: as certified by the applicants, shall be charged a privilege fee of 50% of the cost of the most recent completed betterment, independent of whether they connect at that time or not.

budget_items.topic: Privilege fee for lots connecting after extension acceptance
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Draft policy language would let any lot along an accepted extension connect, at its sole cost, after paying a privilege fee equal to 100% of the most recent betterment.
budget_items.quote: once they have paid a privilege fee equal to 100% of the most recent betterment.
